title: Spec-check questions: filter role text, keep its line breaks, align wrapped lines
lead: *Proposed.* Spec-check question text from a role is filtered with `runrec.PlainText`, split on its line breaks, and each line wrapped at 80 columns. Option lines continue under the label, and the answer prompt wraps.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft of S232 (S188 items 1, 3, 4 and 6) at f48a6154. `printSpecQuestion` (`internal/cli/wave.go:908-944`) prints role-supplied text through `wrapLines` (`internal/cli/prompt.go:26-64`) without `plainLine` or `runrec.PlainText`; the parser trims whitespace only (`internal/engine/report.go:265-279,380-418`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): none of adj 436-443 applies; these items needed no owner choice.

From S232, later notes of S188 (pair wave 3, 2026-11-01), re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S188 item 1 (control characters and flattened lines), still present and security relevant. The spec-check role's report is parsed by `ParseOwnerQuestions`, which only trims whitespace (`internal/engine/report.go:380-418`, `:265-279`). `printSpecQuestion` passes `q.Text`, `q.Ask.Title`, each option's label and summary, `q.Ask.Reason` and `q.Previous` to `wrapLines` (`internal/cli/wave.go:909-931`), which splits on `strings.Fields` (`internal/cli/prompt.go:40`): ESC (0x1b) and BEL (0x07) are not whitespace, so they reach the terminal, and a line break inside the text is folded into a space. adj text is filtered with `plainLine` (`internal/cli/adj.go:97,103`; `internal/cli/prompt.go:66-68`), which removes CSI and OSC sequences and control characters (`internal/runrec/plain.go:22-37`). No test feeds control characters to `printSpecQuestion` (`rg -n 'x1b' internal/cli/spec_questions_test.go internal/cli/wave_test.go` finds none).
- S188 item 3 (option hang), still present. An option line is `  N. LABEL: SUMMARY` and continues with `wrapLines(..., 80, "  ")`, so a continuation starts at column 4 (two leading spaces plus the hang) while the label starts at column 5 (`internal/cli/wave.go:910,928`). Measured with the current `wrapLines`: a 99-character summary gives a second line `    word word ...` (4 spaces).
- S188 item 4 (answer prompt), still present. `Answer 1-N, or type text (empty holds ITEM back): ` and `Answer in text (empty holds ITEM back): ` are printed with `fmt.Fprintf` and never wrapped (`internal/cli/wave.go:956-960`); with a 49-character item id the prompt is 95 characters.
- S188 item 6 (Decision key wrap), still present. The tests use keys `k1` to `k3` and `cache.store` (`internal/cli/spec_questions_test.go:77,152-154`, `internal/cli/wave_test.go:567`); no test wraps a `Decision key:` line.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
Each test calls `printSpecQuestion` or `askSpecQuestions` with a `bytes.Buffer`, `r.Item` `S1` and one question unless stated.

- `TestSpecQuestionDropsControlCharacters`: an ask with title `Store\x1b[31m it?\x07`, one option `file` / `on\x1b]0;t\x07 disk`, recommend 1, reason `fast`, key `k1`, interactive. Output exactly `[S1 1/1] Store it?
  1. file: on disk (recommended)
  Why 1: fast
  Decision key: k1
`. Red first: ESC and BEL are in the output.
- `TestSpecQuestionKeepsTheRoleLineBreaks`: ask nil, text `First line
second line`, previous `old
answer`, non-interactive with address `#1`. Output exactly `[S1 1/1] First line
  second line
  old
  answer
  Answer as: #1
`. Red first: today `[S1 1/1] First line second line` and `  old answer`.
- `TestSpecOptionWrapsUnderItsLabel`: one option `file` with a summary of the word `word` 20 times (99 characters), recommend 1. The option's lines are exactly `  1. file: word word word word word word word word word word word word word word` (80 columns) and `     word word word word word word (recommended)` (5 spaces). With 10 options, option 10's continuation starts with 6 spaces. Red first: 4 spaces.
- `TestSpecAnswerPromptWrapsAt80`: `askSpecQuestions` with item `ork-a-very-long-item-key-for-the-prompt-wrap-test`, a two-option ask, input `1
`. The output contains `Answer 1-2, or type text (empty holds
  ork-a-very-long-item-key-for-the-prompt-wrap-test back): ` (the last line ends with one space and no newline before the answer is read), and no output line is longer than 80 runes. Red first: the prompt is one 95-character line.
- `TestSpecDecisionKeyLineWraps`: non-interactive, key `storage.a-very-long-decision-topic-name-for-the-wrap`, address `S1:` plus the key. The key lines are exactly `  Decision key: storage.a-very-long-decision-topic-name-for-the-wrap (answer as` and `    S1:storage.a-very-long-decision-topic-name-for-the-wrap)`. Passes on arrival (measured with the current `wrapLines`); it pins the wrap that S188 item 6 says no test covers.
- Existing tests whose output must not change for one-line text: `TestBatchOpenAdjHoldsWithoutPrompt` and the other `spec_questions_test.go` tests, and `internal/cli/wave_test.go:567`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and see them red for the stated reason.
2. `internal/cli/prompt.go`: add a helper that takes a prefix, a text and a hang, runs `runrec.PlainText` on the text, splits it on `\n`, prints the first line after the prefix and each later line after the hang, and wraps every line with `wrapLines` at 80. Empty lines from the role are dropped.
3. `printSpecQuestion`: use the helper for `q.Text`, `q.Ask.Title`, `q.Previous`, each option (`LABEL: SUMMARY`, with a hang of `len("N. ")` spaces after the two leading spaces) and the reason. Filter `r.Item` and the key and address with `plainLine`.
4. `askSpecQuestions`: build each prompt text, wrap it at 80 with a two-space hang, print every line but the last with a newline and the last with a trailing space and no newline. Do the same for `Pick 1-N, or type text: `. Also wrap the `ITEM needs N answer(s) before it can start.` header (`internal/cli/wave.go:954`) at 80 with a two-space hang, so no line of the sitting exceeds 80 columns (owner, 2026-11-17).
5. Docs: `docs/guide.md`: one sentence that a role's question text is shown as plain text, line breaks kept. CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.
6. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- A spec-check question whose role text holds ESC or BEL prints with neither byte.
- A question text with a line break prints as two lines.
- A wrapped option continues under its label (column 6 for options 1 to 9).
- The answer prompt never exceeds 80 columns and still waits on its last line.
- A long 'Decision key:' line wraps with a four-space hang, pinned by a test.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/cli -run 'SpecQuestion|SpecOption|SpecAnswer|SpecDecision' -v` lists the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n 'PlainText' internal/cli/prompt.go` finds the helper's filter.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In an 80x24 terminal, run `ork run ork ID` on a slice whose spec check asks a question with an option longer than one line: the option's second line starts under the label, and the `Answer 1-N` prompt fits within 80 columns with the cursor after `back): `.
